National facade/shaft condition is not point-identified; P90 preserves both official good-airtightness cases and forbids a midpoint default.
14/14 P87 strata are promoted from sensitivity to explicit target semantics only. Numeric H_vent bounds are unchanged: 0.35*(0.5+n_filt)*V with target n_filt 0.03..0.06.
Uses 20 C residential service reference and the P86 -12..-10 C current-standard outdoor domain. This is ventilation-only target load, not total building peak.

The inspected current MFB programme page publishes >=30% primary-energy saving and eligible retrofit measures but no building-level n50 target. P90 therefore does not relabel its SCN target as an MFB eligibility condition.
The prospective national reference-programme branch now has an explicit absolute n_filt target surface. Realized/ex-post claims still require project or measurement evidence.

Blower-door, commissioning or equivalent qualified project evidence is required to claim that a realized dwelling achieved the target. This does not block the prospective reference-programme design-load scenario.

P87 supplies physics, P88 path response, P89 measured response/pressure transfer, and P90 the explicit absolute target. The prospective reference-programme ventilation input no longer blocks national design-load materialization.

P90 closes the prospective reference-programme airtightness/ventilation blocker only. Realized airtightness remains record-level Q; independent transmission, geometry, thermal-bridge, location and supply-temperature residuals remain.
